posts.title: Recipe: Roast Tomato & Red Pepper Soup
posts.description: (for the Ninja or other soup maker) I've specified fresh tomatoes in this recipe - the act of roasting them enhances the flavours - you can't do that with tinned. Roasting Ingredients 800g tomatoes (8-9 large tomatoes) 1 or 2 red peppers Olive Oil, Salt, Pepper Base Ingredients 1 Onion, roughly chopped 3-4 cloves garlic, peeled 1 heaped tsp each dried Basil and Oregano 1 tsp Sumac 3/4 tsp Dulce Pi
